scientific_integrity: Exact finite combinatorial classification for all 392 natural isometries, using published nonequivariant homotopy input and provided executable checker; no claim of independent validation or larger parameter family.
scientific_limitations: Only elementwise cyclic fixed spaces of the specified finite natural symmetry group, not fixed loci of all subgroups.
The ambient S3 homotopy equivalence is cited from Adams et al., not independently reproved.
Unindexed equivalent equivariant results are possible.
title: Elementwise fixed-point topology of the seven-by-seven torus Rips three-sphere
